questions.question: Design an experiment to test if caffeine improves reaction time. Identify IV, DV, design, controls, sampling, ethics

points.text: IV: caffeine (200mg vs placebo). DV: reaction time (ms) on computer task. Design: repeated measures (counterbalanced). Controls: same time of day, same task, blind. Sampling: volunteer students (opportunity). Ethics: consent, right to withdraw, debrief, medical screening for caffeine sensitivity
